title_en: Deng Anwei and Song Shunwen — embezzlement, illegal border crossing, and fraud
keywords_en: criminal; embezzlement; illegal border crossing; fraud; first instance; second instance; retrial; Supreme People's Court; High People's Court; Intermediate People's Court; Guizhou Province; natural person; state organ; criminal law; characterization of embezzlement crime; determination of illegal border crossing crime; determination of fraud crime; combined punishment for multiple crimes; affirm the original judgment; bank employee embezzlement of public funds; contract fraud
full_text_en:
Deng Anwei and Song Shunwen — Embezzlement, Illegal Border Crossing, and Fraud Case

Defendant Deng Anwei, female, 37 years old, formerly the chief accountant of Shawan Business Office of Baiyun District, Guiyang Sub-branch of the Agricultural Bank of China. Arrested on March 7, 1989.

Defendant Song Shunwen, male, 55 years old, native of Zhenxiong County, Yunnan Province, formerly an individual industrial and commercial household, sentenced to five years' imprisonment in 1961 for committing the crime of counterrevolution. Arrested on March 7, 1989.

The Guiyang People's Procuratorate, Guizhou Province, instituted a public prosecution with the Guiyang Intermediate People's Court against the defendants Deng Anwei and Song Shunwen for the cases of embezzlement, illegal border crossing, and fraud. The Guiyang Intermediate People's Lawfully formed a collegial panel and, after a public trial, found the following:

In March 1986, the defendant Song Shunwen, when opening an individual enterprise "Shunwen Service Department" in Guiyang, got acquainted with the defendant Deng Anwei through an introduction by another person. The two became close and engaged in an adulterous relationship. Thereafter, from November 2, 1986, to March 10, 1987, Deng Anwei and Song Shunwen colluded with each other: Song Shunwen fabricated remittance units, provided remittance unit accounts, and filled out false remittance vouchers; Deng Anwei, taking advantage of her position as the chief accountant of the bank, used means such as misappropriating inter-branch funds at the county level, making payments without actual funds, intercepting customer current-account funds without temporarily entering them into the payee's account, and concealing the inter-branch funds already used, to remit public funds totalling 143,328.22 yuan into Song Shunwen's account on seven separate occasions. Song Shunwen used the funds to repay debts and engage in individual business operations. On March 10, 1987, after the adulterous relationship between Deng Anwei and Song Shunwen was exposed, fearing that their embezzlement would be discovered, they used the illicit funds to purchase a minitruck and, on August 1 of the same year, illegally crossed the national border and fled abroad. They were repatriated to China on October 18, 1988.

On January 8, 1985, Song Shunwen, together with his son Song Delin, under the pretext of selling steel materials, with Guiyang Shunwen Co., Ltd., which Song Shunwen had established, as the supplier, signed a purchase and sale contract for 100 tons of steel with the Supply and Marketing Company of Xiuwen County Township Enterprise Bureau as the buyer. Song Shunwen postponed the contract signing date by seven days and changed the prepayment of 100,000 yuan into a "loan" entering his account. After obtaining this sum, Song Shunwen had no steel to supply but used 55,000 yuan for profit-making activities.

The above facts are confirmed by documentary evidence, physical evidence, witness testimony, and forensic accounting identification, and the two defendants have also confessed, which is sufficient to establish.

The Guiyang Intermediate People's Court held at the trial: The defendant Deng Anwei, being a state functionary, colluded with the defendant Song Shunwen to jointly steal over 140,000 yuan of public funds from the bank, and her conduct has constituted the crime of embezzlement as provided in Article 155, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China. Deng Anwei and Song Shunwen embezzled a huge amount, and the circumstances of the crime are especially serious, and they should be severely punished according to law. After committing the crime, Deng Anwei and Song Shunwen, in order to evade punishment, violated the laws and regulations governing exit and entry, and illegally crossed the national border, thus having constituted the crime of illegal border crossing as provided in Article 176 of the Criminal Law. Song Shunwen, under the pretext of signing a supply and sales contract, defrauded property, thus having constituted the crime of fraud as provided in Article 152 of the Criminal Law. Deng Anwei and Song Shunwen each committed multiple crimes, and according to Article 64 of the Criminal Law, they should be subject to concurrent punishment for multiple crimes. Accordingly, the Guiyang Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment on June 26, 1989:

The defendant Deng Anwei is sentenced to death for the crime of embezzlement and, according to Article 53, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, shall be deprived of political rights for life; for the crime of illegal border crossing, she is sentenced to one year's imprisonment; it is decided to execute the death penalty and deprive her of political rights for life.

The defendant Song Shunwen is sentenced to death for the crime of embezzlement and, according to Article 53, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, shall be deprived of political rights for life; for the crime of fraud, he is sentenced to eight years' imprisonment; for the crime of illegal border crossing, he is sentenced to one year's imprisonment; it is decided to execute the death penalty and deprive him of political rights for life.

After the judgment of first instance was pronounced, the defendants Deng Anwei and Song Shunwen refused to accept it and appealed to the Guizhou High People's Court on the grounds that "some facts found in the original judgment are inaccurate, the characterization of the crime is improper, and the punishment is excessively severe."

The Guizhou High People's Court held at the trial: The facts found in the original judgment are clear, the evidence is reliable, the conviction is accurate, and the punishment is appropriate. The grounds of appeal raised by the appellants Deng Anwei and Song Shunwen cannot be established. Accordingly, on July 7, 1989, the court, in accordance with Article 136, item (1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, ruled to reject the appeals of the appellants Deng Anwei and Song Shunwen and affirm the original judgment. It also, in accordance with Article 145, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Procedure Law, submitted the case to the Supreme People's Court for review.

The Supreme People's Court, upon review, held: The defendants Deng Anwei and Song Shunwen colluded with each other to jointly steal public funds from the bank; the amount embezzled was huge, and the circumstances of the crime were especially serious; they have constituted the crime of embezzlement and should be severely punished. The two defendants illegally crossed the national border, thus having constituted the crime of illegal border crossing. Song Shunwen, under the pretext of signing a purchase and sale contract, defrauded property, thus having constituted the crime of fraud. The criminal facts found by the courts of first instance and second instance are clear, the evidence is conclusive and sufficient, the conviction is accurate, the punishment is appropriate, and the trial procedure is lawful. Upon discussion and decision by the Judicial Committee, on August 24, 1989, it ruled as follows:

The criminal judgment of the Guizhou High People's Court (89) Xing Jing Shang Zi No. 33, which affirmed the original judgment sentencing the defendant Deng Anwei to death for the crime of embezzlement and deprivation of political rights for life, to one year's imprisonment for the crime of illegal border crossing, and to the combined execution of death and deprivation of political rights for life; and sentencing Song Shunwen to death for the crime of embezzlement and deprivation of political rights for life, to one year's imprisonment for the crime of illegal border crossing, and to eight years' imprisonment for the crime of fraud, and to the combined execution of death and deprivation of political rights for life, is hereby approved.
